mostWorthwhile.text: Combining the dusty cloud with the surviving cluster brought the chapter's histories together through scattered starlight.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding grains to the cold pocket was useful preparation, but less compelling as a decision because its connection to the cluster was initially uncertain.

surprise.text: A cold pocket could survive by radiating away heat even while the much larger surroundings remained hot and thin.

arbitrary.text: No action felt entirely arbitrary, although adding grains was partly a guess about how to reach the illumination goal.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to follow how the surviving cluster and its surroundings change, though the compatible-option menu makes the combinations less about discovery.
